contexts.text: Jacob journeyed to Succoth () = the state of the life of good from truth then... Succoth = the quality of this state.
Booths or tents = the Holy of truth, whereas tabernacles or tents = the Holy of good. The former are called Succoth. That this is the signification of Succoth. Illustrated.

Therefore he called the name of the place Succoth () = the quality of this state... namely, the quality of the state of the Holy in truth from good then. For Succoth means tents, and tents = the Holy of truth. Illustrated.
The sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth () = the first state of the departure and its quality.
They journeyed from Succoth () = the second state after they had been delivered.
